run_create_vasp_inputs_cli: run the create-vasp-inputs CLI to generate VASP input files from CIF crystal structure files
run_relax_vasp_inputs: run the create-vasp-inputs CLI with type relax to generate VASP structure relaxation input files
run_static_vasp_inputs: run the create-vasp-inputs CLI with type static to generate VASP single-point energy input files
create_input_generator_relax: create a RelaxSetGenerator with custom INCAR settings and PBE_54_W_HASH pseudopotential functional
create_input_generator_static: create a StaticSetGenerator with custom INCAR settings and PBE_54_W_HASH pseudopotential functional
